function.name: statled
function.description: Blink the onboard status LED. The LED turns ON for 'high' milliseconds, then OFF for 'low' milliseconds, repeating for 'count' cycles. Time unit is milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). If count = 0, the blinking repeats forever.

high.description: LED ON duration in milliseconds (e.g. 1000 = 1 second)

low.description: LED OFF duration in milliseconds (e.g. 1000 = 1 second)

count.description: Number of blink cycles. 0 means repeat forever.
